fleet.status: White Model 3 / Model Y · revised Blender models
fleet.detail: Both production cars are white, with slimmer Model 3 headlights, the current Model Y lightbar, revised glazing and roof rails, and Model Y crossover cladding. These are simplified public-photo-inspired models. This image is rendered in Blender Cycles; the interactive campus uses Three.js/WebGL.
